description: This file defines the CordRepBtreeReader class, which provides iteration, navigation, and data access methods for cord btrees within the Abseil string library. It includes methods for initialization, moving to next data chunks, skipping bytes, reading data, and seeking to specific offsets.

classes.name: CordRepBtreeReader
classes.description: A class that implements iteration and navigation over cord btrees, returning data as string views and supporting skip, seek, and read operations.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total length of the referenced btree.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reader with a given CordRepBtree and returns the first data edge.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next data chunk in the btree iteration.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of bytes and returns the following data chunk.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes into a CordRep, optionally starting from a specific chunk offset.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific byte offset within the btree and returns a view into that position.
